email_subject: Application for Programme Management and Web Content Officer
email_body:
Dear Eureka Network Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Programme Management and Web Content Officer position at Eureka Network AISBL. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in web content management, SEO, and data handling, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of supporting international R&D collaboration.

In my current role at Episto, I manage WordPress sites, upload and update content, and ensure accuracy and clarity on client pages. I am comfortable with digital tools and shared platforms, and I have a keen eye for detail. My experience with structured data and content organization aligns well with your need for precise web content administration.

I am particularly drawn to the expert database support aspect, as I enjoy working with data and maintaining organized records. I am eager to learn how international funding programmes operate and to support your team across communications and operations.

I am based in Belgium and have the legal right to work here. I am available to start as soon as possible.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Eureka's impactful work.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Eureka Network Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Programme Management and Web Content Officer position at Eureka Network AISBL. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in web content management, SEO, and data handling, I am drawn to this role's unique blend of communications and programme support, and I am eager to contribute to your mission of fostering international R&D collaboration.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage WordPress websites for clients, including uploading and updating content, ensuring pages are accurate and clearly presented, and applying web content standards. My attention to detail and structured approach have helped improve organic visibility and user experience. I am confident in my ability to handle the web content administration duties, from coordinating with programme colleagues to collecting information for call pages, to maintaining organized and up-to-date content.

I am equally enthusiastic about the expert database support component. My experience with data-driven tasks, such as tracking site performance using analytics tools and maintaining client records, has prepared me to help maintain the expert pool. I am comfortable with shared documents and databases, and I approach data handling with care and precision. I am also keen to learn how international R&D funding programmes work, and I believe this role offers a perfect opportunity to gain that insight.

What particularly attracts me to Eureka is its international, collaborative environment and its commitment to creating positive socio-economic impact. I am a quick learner, adaptable, and enjoy supporting colleagues across teams. I am based in Belgium and have the legal right to work here, and I am available to start as soon as possible.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Eureka. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
